seoProjects.name: FoodCopycat.com
seoProjects.summary: Full-stack launch SEO (On-Page, Technical & Off-Page) driving first-page Google rankings and 17K+ impressions.
seoProjects.overview: FoodCopycat.com is a copycat recipes and cooking tips blog launched in August 2025, scaled with on-page, technical, and off-page SEO.
objectives: Improve organic traffic and search visibility.
Enhance user engagement and session duration.
Optimize content for better reach and relevance.
Increase search engine rankings for targeted keywords.

contributions.title: Local SEO & On-Page SEO
contributions.intro: To establish FoodCopycat.com as a reliable resource in its niche, we implemented a targeted SEO strategy:

items.label: Keyword Optimization
items.detail: Identified high-traffic keywords like “Omakase Sauce”, “Cajun Burger”, and “KFC Stacker sauce”, integrating them into blog posts, meta descriptions, and service pages.

items.label: Content Optimization
items.detail: Improved existing articles and created new high-quality content to satisfy user intent and increase search relevance, including optimized meta tags and structured data implementation.

items.label: Technical SEO
items.detail: Optimized website structure, Google Search Console setup, site speed, mobile responsiveness, and implemented structured data.

items.label: Review & Engagement Signals
items.detail: Monitored user behavior to improve internal linking, readability, and session duration.

contributions.result: Organic traffic grew steadily, and multiple blog posts ranked on Google’s first page for targeted and long-tail keywords.

contributions.title: Off-Page SEO
contributions.intro: To enhance domain authority and overall visibility:

items.label: Link Building
items.detail: Built high-quality backlinks from relevant and authoritative websites.

items.label: Outreach
items.detail: Collaborated with influencers and websites in the niche to improve traffic and referral links.

items.label: Content Marketing
items.detail: Promoted blog content across social media and online platforms to drive engagement and build credibility.

contributions.result: The website achieved better keyword rankings and increased impressions in search results, improving overall visibility.

results: Traffic Growth: Organic traffic has shown consistent growth since the website launch through regular content publishing and SEO optimization.
Keyword Rankings: Multiple blog posts appeared on Google’s first page for targeted and long-tail keywords within a short time period.
Overall Keyword Visibility: Overall keyword visibility improved, helping the website gain better impressions in search results.
User Engagement: Session duration improved and bounce rate decreased due to enhanced content structure, readability, better internal linking, and improved page experience.
Content Authority: Built credibility in the niche through high-quality blogs and backlinks.
seoProjects.impactSummary: By applying a comprehensive SEO strategy and combining technical expertise with content optimization, we helped FoodCopycat.com grow into a competitive and authoritative resource in its niche.

faqs.question: What SEO services do you provide?
faqs.answer: I provide on-page SEO, technical SEO, off-page SEO, backlink building, content optimization, blog writing and other website optimization services.

faqs.question: Do you build WordPress websites from scratch?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can design and build custom WordPress websites from scratch, including responsive layouts and Elementor Pro-based website development.

faqs.question: Can you work on an existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can work on existing websites for SEO optimization, website improvements, content updates, technical SEO and design modifications.

faqs.question: How long does an SEO project take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the website, competition and project requirements. SEO projects can range from a few months to longer-term ongoing optimization.

faqs.question: Do you provide blog writing services?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can create SEO-focused blog content based on relevant topics and search intent, with content structured to support organic visibility.

faqs.question: Can you manage social media marketing projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. I also work on social media marketing, content planning, social media management and digital advertising content.
